description_for_human: Public Block Lottos APIs for lottery data, advertising, affiliates, and Base agent ticket preparation. One Base Future Ledger ticket costs exactly 1 USDC; Base ETH is required only for network gas.
description_for_model: Use the API to read Polygon and Base lottery data, advertising options, affiliate information, and Base-first non-custodial ticket preparation. One Base Future Ledger ticket costs exactly 1 USDC using official Base USDC. Base ETH is required only for network gas; ETH and SOL are not the Base ticket payment currency. A verified winning Polygon ticket receives at least 100 POL; a verified winning Base ticket receives at least 100 USDC. If the current jackpot is higher, the higher amount applies. Never claim any ticket is guaranteed to win.
